segments.sn17.28:1.3: Lābhasakkārasiloko, bhikkhave, chaviṃ chindati, chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati, cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati, maṃsaṃ chetvā nhāruṃ chindati, nhāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati, aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn17.28:1.4: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe …

lines: Aṭṭhame yasmā lābhasakkārasiloko narakādīsu, nibbattento sakalampi imaṃ attabhāvaṃ nāseti, idhāpi maraṇampi maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ āvahati, tasmā chaviṃ chindatītiādi vuttaṃ.
Lābhasakkārasiloko narakādīsu nibbattentoti idaṃ tannissayaṃ kilesagaṇaṃ sandhāyāha.
Imaṃ manussa attabhāvaṃ nāseti manussattaṃ puna nibbattituṃ appadānavasena.
